title: Senior embedded developer, truck ECU platform
brief:
# Assignment request: Senior embedded developer, truck ECU platform
Our client is a major Swedish truck OEM, seeking a Senior Embedded Developer to contribute to the development of their next-generation truck ECU platform. This project is critical to enhancing vehicle performance and safety features. The role is based in Gothenburg and is expected to last for 12 months, with a start date approximately two months from now.

## Requirements
- AUTOSAR Classic
- Embedded C
- CAN bus
- ISO 26262
- MISRA C
- At least 5 years of relevant experience
- Substantial experience from the automotive domain is required.

## Meriting
- Vector CANoe
- ASPICE
- Simulink
notes: Bread-and-butter automotive embedded profile; several strong matches should exist.

title: AUTOSAR Adaptive engineer, software-defined vehicle
brief:
# Assignment request: AUTOSAR Adaptive engineer, software-defined vehicle
Our client is a Nordic passenger-car OEM, known for its innovative approach to automotive engineering and commitment to sustainability. They are currently developing a software-defined vehicle platform that leverages the AUTOSAR Adaptive architecture. The team is expanding to meet project demands and is looking for an experienced engineer to join them in Gothenburg for an 18-month engagement, starting in approximately two months.

## Requirements
- AUTOSAR Adaptive
- C++
- SOME/IP
- At least 5 years of relevant experience
- Substantial experience from the automotive domain is required.

## Meriting
- Ethernet TSN
- QNX
- ISO 21434
- Yocto
notes: Small strong pool by design (adaptive is a scarcer skill); partials are classic-platform people.

title: 5G RAN developer, cloud-native baseband
brief:
# Assignment request: 5G RAN developer, cloud-native baseband
Our client is a Nordic telecom equipment vendor seeking to enhance their 5G offerings. They are developing a cloud-native baseband solution to improve network efficiency and scalability. The team is currently expanding to meet project demands and aims to start onboarding new developers in approximately two months. The position is based in Stockholm (Kista) and is expected to last for 12 months.

## Requirements
- 5G RAN
- C++ or Golang
- Kubernetes
- At least 3 years of relevant experience
- Substantial experience from the telecom domain is required.

## Meriting
- O-RAN
- DPDK
- GitLab CI
- Helm
notes: C++ or Golang both accepted; 5G Core people are the engineered near-miss (wrong network layer).

title: DevOps engineer, embedded build & test infrastructure
brief:
# Assignment request: DevOps engineer, embedded build & test infrastructure
Our client is a German premium car manufacturer, known for its innovative automotive solutions and commitment to quality. They are currently developing advanced embedded systems for their next generation of vehicles and require a skilled DevOps engineer to enhance their build and test infrastructure. The project is set to last for 12 months, based in Gothenburg with a hybrid working model, and is expected to commence in approximately two months.

## Requirements
- Proficiency in Jenkins or GitLab CI
- Proficiency in Docker
- Proficiency in Python
- Proficiency in Yocto
- At least 3 years of relevant experience
- Substantial experience from the automotive domain is required.

## Meriting
- Experience with Artifactory
- Experience with Kubernetes
- Experience with dSPACE HIL
- Experience with Ansible
notes: Yocto in a CI context separates embedded DevOps from generic DevOps.

title: Cloud platform engineer, connected-vehicle backend
brief:
# Assignment request: Cloud platform engineer, connected-vehicle backend

We are partnering with a Swedish electric-vehicle startup that is revolutionizing the automotive industry with their innovative technologies. Their product aims to enhance the connected-vehicle experience, enabling seamless communication between vehicles and their ecosystems. The team is currently looking to expand for a duration of 9 months, with a flexible location in Stockholm, allowing for remote work. The ideal candidate is expected to start in approximately two months.

## Requirements
- AWS or Azure
- Kubernetes
- Terraform
- At least 4 years of relevant experience

## Meriting
- Kafka
- MQTT
- Helm
- Golang  
Experience from automotive or connected-vehicle projects is meriting but not required.
notes: Domain kept a soft preference on purpose: tests that the matcher does not over-filter on domain.

title: Embedded Linux BSP engineer, radio units
brief:

Our client, a European 5G infrastructure vendor, is seeking an experienced Embedded Linux BSP engineer to join their team focused on developing cutting-edge radio units for next-generation telecommunications. The project is anticipated to last for 12 months, with a start date approximately two months from now. The position can be based in Helsinki or performed remotely.

## Requirements
- Embedded Linux
- Yocto
- Embedded C
- device drivers
- at least 4 years of relevant experience

## Meriting
- secure boot
- Rust
- Zephyr
- C++
notes: BSP work: driver experience is the discriminator.

title: Functional safety lead, ADAS platform
brief:
# Assignment request: Functional safety lead, ADAS platform

Our client is a tier-1 automotive supplier, recognized for its cutting-edge contributions to the automotive industry. They are currently developing advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) and require a Functional Safety Lead to ensure compliance with safety standards. The team is dynamic and collaborative, aiming to enhance vehicle safety and performance. This position is based in Gothenburg, with a duration of 24 months, starting in approximately two months.

## Requirements
- ISO 26262
- MISRA C
- ASPICE
- At least 7 years of relevant experience
- Proficiency in Swedish is mandatory
- Substantial experience from the automotive domain is required

## Meriting
- AUTOSAR Classic
- ISO 21434
- Vector CANoe
- Simulink
notes: Swedish is a hard requirement (safety audits and supplier meetings run in Swedish).

title: Edge platform engineer, secure telecom workloads
brief:
# Assignment request: Edge platform engineer, secure telecom workloads

Our client is a Finnish network operator seeking to enhance their infrastructure for secure telecom workloads. The team is currently working on a cutting-edge project aimed at optimizing their 5G capabilities. This 12-month assignment is based in Helsinki, with an expected start date in approximately two months.

## Requirements
- Must have experience with 5G RAN or 5G Core
- Must have experience with Kubernetes
- Must have experience with secure boot
- At least 5 years of relevant experience
- Substantial experience from the telecom domain is required.

## Meriting
- DPDK
- Helm
- GitLab CI
- Rust
notes: DELIBERATELY UNSATISFIABLE: no persona combines 5G + Kubernetes + secure boot. The correct output is an honest 'no full match' plus the nearest partials.

title: Inbyggd mjukvaruutvecklare, hyttelektronik
brief:
# Uppdragsförfrågan: Inbyggd mjukvaruutvecklare, hyttelektronik  
Vår klient är en stor svensk lastbils-OEM. De arbetar med att utveckla avancerade hyttelektroniklösningar för sina fordon och söker nu förstärkning till sitt team. Uppdraget varar i 12 månader och är beläget i Göteborg, med planerad start om cirka två månader.

## Krav
- AUTOSAR Classic
- Embedded C
- Vector CANoe
- Minst 4 års relevant erfarenhet
- Svenska är ett krav

## Meriterande
- LIN
- Simulink
- dSPACE HIL
notes: CROSS-LINGUAL: the whole brief is written in Swedish (a Swedish client to a Swedish consultancy) while every CV is English. Technology names keep their canonical English spelling, so the taxonomy checks still hold; no OR-groups on purpose (the or-phrasing check is English-only). Tests that extraction and matching survive the language boundary.
